name: Charcoal Stick 26
notes: Charcoal on toothy paper. The texture channel IS the paper: a rank-equalized fractal tooth field (tips/charcoal.spec.json, canvas-anchored so overlapping strokes share their grain) carves the stroke in subtract mode - the contact model of docs/fractal-texture-math.md: a pixel inks where tooth height exceeds 1 minus accumulated alpha, so PRESSURE is the coverage dial, continuously, instead of a nine-member family. Flow is spread over a fine spacing (8%) so the accumulation exponent, not any single dab, sets the press depth - coarse spacing at the same deposit re-exposes the stamp comb through the carve's threshold (tried at 25% spacing: visible pickets). Build-up over repeated passes fills the tooth progressively, like real charcoal. This is the point of the stick: a small ragged chalk tip with a higher K (~2.5) so lines hold together, the tooth still breaking a light line into grain.
